task: Work in the supplied fixtures/C05/repo starter by copying it into trial/artifact. This is an existing React + TypeScript + Vite billing screen with a small purple brand system in src/styles.css. Preserve its stack, CSS variables, existing screen content and overall visual character. Make one targeted change: add a “Payment schedule” disclosure to each invoice row. Each disclosure must toggle that row's schedule details without changing other rows, use a native button with aria-expanded/aria-controls, and show the invoice's due date plus its three supplied payment entries. It must be usable with a keyboard, show visible focus, and keep the table/card content readable at 375px. Add only the structure and styling needed for that feature; do not redesign the page, replace its CSS, add a UI kit, fetch data or introduce a router. Use the existing package scripts for the appropriate checks. Summarize the changed files and any checks you could not execute. Write trial/result.json using the supplied output contract.

outputContract.note: The orchestrator supplies caseId, arm, run and trial directory. Checks use PASS, FAIL, UNVERIFIED or NOT_APPLICABLE and cite observable evidence. Never invent tool access or executed checks.
